faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Jammu Project Technical Support – II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Technical Support – II post at AIIMS Jammu is 10th August 2026. Ensure all details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support – II position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 3-year Graduate degree in relevant fields such as Social Sciences, Social Work, Sociology, Public Policy and Administration, Community Health, Public Health, or Medical/Allied Sciences, along with two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support – II position is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government regulations.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification states that there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support – II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 22,000 per month for the Project Technical Support – II position.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Technical Support – II role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application, followed by shortlisting based on merit, and finally an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Project Technical Support – II position at AIIMS Jammu.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It contains all detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Technical Support – II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Technical Support – II position announced in this recruitment drive by AIIMS Jammu.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jammu, Vijaypur, Jammu and Kashmir.
